description: Find the category id a marketplace uses, to link it to a catalog category. Read-only. Pass the platform (prom, rozetka, olx, amazon or google_merchant) and a query, or for OLX and Rozetka a parentId to browse one level of the tree (no query and no parentId lists the top level). Sources differ: Google Merchant searches the bundled Google product taxonomy and needs no connection; OLX, Rozetka and Amazon ask the marketplace through the connected adapter (connected tells you whether one exists); Prom publishes no category directory, so only rubrics already seen on this merchant's own Prom listings are returned (partial tells you the list may be incomplete, note explains why). OLX only accepts a LEAF category: check isLeaf and keep browsing with parentId until you reach one. Results are candidates for the USER to choose from: when several fit, show them and ask, never pick one silently. Then pass the chosen id in marketplaceCategories of update_category or create_category.

parentId.description: Browse one level of the marketplace tree under this id (OLX and Rozetka). Omit, together with query, to list the top level.

platform.description: The marketplace whose categories to look up.

query.description: Words describing the shelf, e.g. the CRM category's name ('кросівки', 'running shoes'). At least two characters.
